pages.title: Sources and repeat use
pages.text: Every successfully consumed pill adds toxicity once, including doses that restore over time. Potency and quality use current server rules, even for old saved pills. Default base gain is 4 × pill potency; common / fine / superior quality multiply it by 1 / 0.75 / 0.5. Pills have a configured medicinal realm (most ordinary pills: Qi Refining; breakthrough pill: Foundation).

pages.title: Sources and repeat use
pages.text: Each realm above you multiplies toxicity by 1.75; each below multiplies it by 0.85. Saved pill realm metadata, when present, is respected. Each earlier repeat of the SAME pill in a chain that resets after 120 online seconds without that pill adds 35% gain, up to five repeats. Different pill types track separately. The tooltip previews your next gain.

pages.title: Stages and warnings
pages.text: Default stages: 0–19 Pure; 20–39 Mild; 40–59 Accumulated; 60–79 Meridian Poisoning; 80–100 Marrow Poisoning. Screen corners begin with green mist, progressing to green-purple edges, slow purple veins and deep violet miasma. The aiming center stays clear. A brief edge label announces a worse stage; recovery allows a later warning. Open Pill Toxicity from statistics for the ACTUAL server multipliers.

pages.title: Stages and warnings
pages.text: Open Toxicity Visual Settings from the main configuration menu or toxicity details page to disable screen effects or adjust opacity (default 60%). Mist and veins blend continuously with your actual toxicity; the center stays clear. These client settings change no mechanics.

pages.title: Total penalties
pages.text: Each stage uses its total multiplier once. Mild: pill healing/Qi 90%. Accumulated: healing/Qi 75%, other numeric pill benefits 90%, natural Qi 85%. Meridian: 60% / 80% / 70%, cultivation 85%, spell costs 115%. Marrow: 40% / 65% / 50%, cultivation 65%, spell costs 130%; lose 1% maximum HP every 10 seconds, never below 1 HP. Trigger chances, permanent legacy unlocks and fixed vanilla effects retain their behavior.

pages.title: Total penalties
pages.text: Restoration penalties apply to instant and ongoing doses without compounding per tick. Natural Qi and pill restoration are separate.

pages.title: Recovering safely
pages.text: Online play removes 0.01 points/second. Meditation adds 0.04 points/second. Leaving meditation stops the bonus; damage interrupts meditation and blocks its bonus for 5 seconds. No offline detox. Death clears toxicity and repeat records; logout and changing dimensions do not. Qingdu Pill removes 25 points, adds no toxicity, requires Qi Refining or higher, and has a server-enforced 300-second ONLINE cooldown.

pages.title: Recovering safely
pages.text: During cooldown, below its realm requirement, or while already clean, it cannot be consumed. Its tooltip shows the limit and remaining time.

pages.title: Qingdu formula
pages.text: Refine 3 Harmonizing Herbs, 2 Spirit Spring Leaves and 1 Profound Ice Lotus using the Qingdu Pill Formula at 1200°C in a ding. Base yield: 5. Obtain the formula through the usual formula shop or merchant routes. All numbers here describe defaults; server config may change them. Statistics and tooltips show your current server rules.
